svg.text: OWASP LLM Top 10 — how the practices map

g.text: RISK
POSTURE
LLM01 Prompt injection
Delimited input wrapping · first-party-only RAG corpus · advisory output bounds impact
LLM02 Insecure output handling
Fixed JSON contract + server-side enum validation · HTML-escaped rendering · no CoT variants
LLM04 Model DoS
Token budgets · explicit context windows · timeouts + circuit breakers · batched loops
LLM05 Supply chain
Offline artefact channel · pinning + SBOM + audit gate — proven by a caught malicious dep
LLM06 Sensitive info disclosure
No egress · data-at-rest capped/gated/documented · telemetry opt-in and first-party
LLM07/08 Plugins & agency
No autonomous tool execution · deterministic-first · AI tool surface off by default, per-tool perms
LLM09 Overreliance
Ledger makes AI/analyst disagreement visible · confidence surfaced · auto-escalation states
LLM03/10 Poisoning & theft
No in-boundary training · artefact provenance · weights behind platform access controls
NO SINGLE LAYER IS THE ANSWER. Injection defence = wrapping + contract + advisory-only. Disclosure defence =
no egress + governed data-at-rest + opt-in telemetry. Every row above is two or more principles working together.
